svg.title: VTE study workflow
svg.desc: Case preparation and role-specific retrieval, parallel specialist assessment, coordinator synthesis, targeted review and revision, and planned comparative evaluation.
svg.text: VTE anticoagulation: RAG, multi-agent review and follow-up
Evidence-supported recommendations from available information, with explicit assumptions
References remain linked to their source and version
Shared plan + role sections + explicit assumptions
First pass: A + B + C | Later passes: affected roles only
Reviewed draft + conditions + citations + revision trail
Available for physician review and sign-off
No need to complete every field
Routine gaps are optional. Missing facts remain unknown; decision-changing gaps become assumptions.
Latency, model calls and token usage
Paired case-level comparisons | Ablation analysis | Prespecified clinical subgroups
VTE: venous thromboembolism DVT: deep vein thrombosis PE: pulmonary embolism RAG: retrieval-augmented generation
